name: Hachijō (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hachijō town emblem in white: a stylised human figure with outstretched arms, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hachijō, a town in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 October 1957.

features.role: Hachijō town emblem — a stylised human figure with outstretched arms, like a stylised character
